title: Feature Comparison Table
userStory: As a potential customer, I want to be able to compare different subscription plans and features so that I can make a good decision
summary: A feature comparison table for side-by-side plan comparison with sticky headers and differences filtering.
features: Clear feature availability indicators using checkmarks and x-marks
Sticky header row with plan names and CTA buttons
Toggle to show only feature differences between plans
Categorized feature sections with icons and anchor links
longDescription:
## Purpose

The PricingTable component provides a detailed, structured comparison of all features across subscription plans. It enables potential customers to make informed decisions by clearly showing what is included in each tier, reducing confusion and building trust through transparent feature presentation.

## Use Cases

- Present all plan features organized into logical categories with section headers and icons
- Use checkmarks and x-marks to clearly indicate feature availability per plan
- Allow users to toggle a differences-only view to quickly identify distinguishing features
- Keep plan headers sticky while scrolling so users always know which column they are viewing
- Link feature names to detailed documentation or anchor points on other pages
- Highlight premium values (like unlimited) with rainbow text styling

## Design Rationale

Well-structured feature information helps users understand plan value and decide confidently. The sticky header ensures plan context is never lost during long table scrolling. The differences toggle reduces cognitive load by focusing attention on what varies between plans. CTA buttons in headers provide convenient subscription access from anywhere in the table.
